protect-long-underlying.label: Protect Long Underlying
protect-long-underlying.description: Use option overlays to protect an existing stock or ETF position.
protect-long-underlying.positionDescription: You own the underlying and want to reduce downside exposure without selling the position.
protect-long-underlying.hedgeDescription: Add a protective put, put spread, or collar to define the downside zone and compare the new payoff.
protect-long-underlying.beforeRiskNote: The original long underlying position has full downside exposure until the position is sold or hedged.
protect-long-underlying.operatingRule: Use this hedge when downside protection is more important than preserving all upside or avoiding hedge cost.
protect-long-underlying.tradeOff: Protection has a cost. Collars can reduce or offset that cost, but they usually cap upside.

repair-short-put.label: Repair Short Put / Naked Put
repair-short-put.description: Define or reduce risk on a challenged short put position.
repair-short-put.positionDescription: You are short a put and the underlying is moving toward or below the strike.
repair-short-put.hedgeDescription: Buy a lower-strike put to convert the short put into a defined-risk spread, or compare the repair alternatives later.
repair-short-put.beforeRiskNote: A short put has substantial downside exposure. If assignment is not desired, risk definition becomes more important as price approaches the strike.
repair-short-put.operatingRule: Consider this repair when the short put is near or below the strike and assignment is not desired.
repair-short-put.tradeOff: Buying protection reduces open downside, but lowers the net credit and can move the breakeven against the trader.
repair-short-put.riskProfile: Defined risk after buying lower put

repair-short-call.label: Repair Short Call / Naked Call
repair-short-call.description: Define or reduce risk on a challenged short call position.
repair-short-call.positionDescription: You are short a call and the underlying is moving toward or above the strike.
repair-short-call.hedgeDescription: Buy a higher-strike call to convert the short call into a defined-risk spread, or reduce directional exposure later.
repair-short-call.beforeRiskNote: A naked short call has theoretically unlimited upside risk. Risk definition usually takes priority over preserving premium.
repair-short-call.operatingRule: If a short call is moving against you, defining risk usually comes before chasing more premium.
repair-short-call.tradeOff: Buying a higher call caps risk, but reduces or can reverse the original credit.

stock-break-even-repair.label: Stock Break-even Repair
stock-break-even-repair.description: Use option overlays to improve the recovery profile of a losing long stock position.
stock-break-even-repair.positionDescription: You own the underlying below cost basis and want to improve the recovery profile.
stock-break-even-repair.hedgeDescription: Use a stock repair structure, covered call, or collar to shift the recovery profile while making upside caps explicit.
stock-break-even-repair.beforeRiskNote: The original long stock position still has downside exposure and requires a full recovery to return to cost basis.
stock-break-even-repair.operatingRule: Use only when the investor is willing to cap part of the upside in exchange for a lower recovery threshold.
stock-break-even-repair.tradeOff: Repair structures can improve the path toward breakeven, but usually cap upside or add complexity.
stock-break-even-repair.riskProfile: Recovery profile improved, upside partly capped
